name: Bora Bora
about: May–Oct is drier and cooler, Nov–Apr is warmer and wetter with occasional cyclone risk.
overview: The overwater-bungalow icon — a single volcanic island ringed by one of the most photographed lagoons on Earth.
costOverview: One of the most expensive places on the planet to eat even a casual meal — there's no discount version of Bora Bora.
